evals.prompt: Write scripts/Remove-OldFiles.ps1: recursively delete files older than N days (default 30) under a given folder, following the conventions in README.md. Show how to dry-run it against sample/.
evals.expected_output: Recursive deletion cmdlet is used with error boundaries.
expectations: Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File with a LastWriteTime filter and Remove-Item are used correctly
Parameters are validated (mandatory existing path, positive day count) and SupportsShouldProcess enables -WhatIf
Errors are handled with try/catch (or -ErrorAction Stop) without aborting the whole run on one locked file
Each removed file is logged with Write-Verbose or Write-Information, and a -WhatIf dry run against sample/ is shown
